name: GU10
variant: GU10 fixtures and accessories for flexible lamp-based accent and downlighting.
overview: The GU10 range covers fixtures and accessories built around the universal GU10 lamp format, providing a simple, serviceable solution for accent and downlighting applications where lamp replacement flexibility is required.
notes: Due to the rapid development in LED technology the performance values, power consumption and lumen output levels stated above are subject to change without prior notice.
Due to the interoperability of LED modules and drivers, up to a 10% deviation in these values is possible.
Nominal flux values are stated at 25° C, based on LED manufacturer's data.
Installation environmental conditions may impact the performance and efficiency of the luminaire.
